summary.intent: Execute GSD phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration) for CipherBox end-to-end — wire the v2.0 web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain via wave-based parallel plan execution, run gap-closure rounds driven by verification and live user bug reports, and finally ship the phase via /ship-phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 reached verification PASSED 5/5 after 33 plans and multiple gap-closure rounds (e2e failures dropped 11→2, with the 2 remaining being explicitly human-approved deferrals); deferral todos were captured and /ship-phase was launched (security audit, Nyquist validation, simplify review, SDK E2E gate, and CodeRabbit review all in progress when the transcript ends).

repo: CipherBox write-plane model: WriteChildRef is keyed by node UUID (childPub.id), never the ipnsName-based handle used for reads (SealedChildRef) — conflating the two silently breaks write-capability checks.
getWriteBodyParams fail-opens to {} on a zero writeKey — any code path that loses/never-populates a folder's writeKey silently strips the write-body from subsequent publishes instead of erroring.

TEE republish enrollment requires both encryptedIpnsPrivateKey AND keyEpoch on POST /ipns/publish; createFolder previously omitted enrollment entirely, so subfolder IPNS records had zero rows in ipns_republish_schedule and died at TTL.

mock-ipns-routing (dev delegated-routing mock, :3001) keeps records in an in-memory Map wiped on every container restart; only records with a DB row (apps/api ipns_records) written at publish time survive restarts — folders created before that DB row existed are permanently dead.

mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used busybox `wget localhost`, which resolves to ::1 while the app binds IPv4-only — always failed as 'unhealthy' even when the service was fine; fix is wget 127.0.0.1.
API runs on :3000, not :3001 — :3001 is the delegated-routing mock used by web-e2e's DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL.

dfsFindFolder previously always re-resolved and overwrote every intermediate ancestor's folderTree entry on every call, even already-loaded write-capable ones — this caused breadcrumb navigation to silently clobber a loaded ancestor mid-descent. Fix: short-circuit when an already-cached entry is write-capable.

apps/web/src/stores/folder.store.ts's SDK-event handler needed a hybrid sync/async kind-resolution: synchronous insert only when every child's kind is already cached, else an await-guarded resolveKinds path with a stale-sequence check — three separate sinks (subscribeToSdk handler, handleSync, resyncFolder) all needed the same fix.

migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped the shares table's plaintext item_name column entirely (not renamed), making the REQ-4 itemName-backfill feature permanently dead code post-cutover — reviving it as plaintext would violate the zero-knowledge rule; the fix is an encrypted item_name_encrypted/ECIES redesign, which was already partially scaffolded server-side.

apps/web/public/recovery.html (last touched Phase 24) only accepts legacy v2 single-key vault blobs / v2 schema metadata; the app has produced v3/node-v3 vault blobs and metadata since Phase 62 — recovery flow is permanently broken until it's ported to v3.

moveItem never re-homed the moved child's WriteChildRef from source to destination write-body (a gap dating to 68.1-02) — files moved into subfolders lost write-capability forever; fix must key the re-homed ref by resolved node UUID, not moveItem's ipnsName-based childId param.

Shared-folder write access was seeded only at share root depth (68.1-20 scope boundary) — navigating into nested shared subfolders left writeKey zeroed, blocking deep shared writes; fix mirrors the owned-tree dfsFindFolder walk via a new resolveSharedSubfolderWriteKey.

Single-file shares hit a double gap: the auto-open effect synthesized readKeySealed:'' with folderKey:null (empty editor), and updateSharedFile presumed a parent-folder write context that a single-file share never has — needed a dedicated updateSharedSingleFile SDK method targeting the file's own IPNS.

1Password git-commit hook produces false-negative timeouts (exit 143) even when the commit actually lands — must verify via `git log -1`/`git log --oneline -1` before ever retrying, never blind-retry.
gsd-tools check subcommand for the TDD gate is `tdd-review-checkpoint`, not `tdd-gate`; schema drift check requires `verify schema-drift <phase>`.

Playwright test-results/ and .last-run.json get wiped on each run and this project's config doesn't produce a reliably pollable progress artifact — mtime-based watchdogs on it can silently never fire.
CodeRabbit CLI review has a 150-file diff limit; a 179-file phase diff must be split into directory-scoped passes.

GSD executor commits use a non-conventional `feat 51-03:` style that fails the pr-release-preview CI gate — must be reworded to conventional format via git filter-branch before opening a PR (git rebase -i is unavailable in this environment).

code.finding: getWriteBodyParams fails open to {} when writeKey is zero, silently dropping the write-body from a publish.

moveItem (68.1-31) now re-homes the moved child's WriteChildRef from source to dest write-body, keyed by resolved node UUID (childPub.id) at destEntry.generation, with dest-before-source publish order preserved and terminal-owner zeroization.

updateSharedSingleFile (68.1-32) added to support write-capable direct single-file shares, unwrapping readDescriptorRef/writeDescriptorRef and delegating to the existing file-node republish path (shareOps.updateSharedFile).

subscribeToSdk handler (68.1-33) hybrid-projects: synchronous insert when all child kinds are already cached, otherwise an awaited resolveKinds path guarded against stale sequence numbers; the 68.1-26 empty-over-non-empty guard (lines ~216-237) preserved unchanged.
handleSync — the actual reload-gating inserter that bypasses SDK events on FileBrowser mount — needed the same await-resolveKinds-before-insert fix as the store handler.
hardcoded isFolder = true, meaning the D-02 kind cache populated elsewhere was never consulted in the shared browser — files rendered/treated as folders.

workflow: Background subagents that launch long-running background bash (e.g. a 20-min e2e suite) frequently never get re-woken when the run completes — the transcript can get evicted in the meantime. Mitigate with an independent disk-based watchdog plus a SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm; if evicted, spawn a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed-state context.
Never run full monorepo test suites concurrently from parallel subagents — starves RAM; scope test gates to the specific packages touched.

When a live e2e suite uses describe.serial per file, a single early failure cascades and skips the rest of that file's tests — a raw 'N failed' count understates real breakage since most failing groups die in setup before exercising their actual coverage.

Hands-on manual testing by the user caught three real bugs (cold-load subfolder navigation, text-editor decryption-failed, move-then-edit write loss) that the automated e2e suite structurally could not reach because serial cascade-aborts shadowed the deeper specs — 'suite green' does not mean every code path was exercised.

When an executor agent dies mid-task on an account session limit, recovery is: spot-check disk state, validate any uncommitted plan/artifact, commit it, run the checker, and redispatch — rather than restarting the whole plan from scratch.

Track worktree-metadata self-reports skeptically — at least one agent misreported its own expected_base as its own HEAD commit rather than the true fork point; verify with `git merge-base` before recording in the wave manifest.

Multiple executor agents violated the no-git-stash rule under time pressure; both incidents were self-caught and reverted (stash pop / manual reapply) before committing, but left stray stash entries requiring manual cleanup — reinforce the rule harder in agent dispatch prompts.

friction: Wave-1 executor stream-stalled mid-run (~23 min in) requiring a manual disk spot-check and SendMessage resume.

Exit-gate agents repeatedly parked themselves waiting on their own background e2e suite and never woke on completion (happened at least 3 separate times across gap rounds), requiring manual detection and resume.
A stat-based watchdog built to detect e2e completion never fired because this project's playwright config doesn't produce the expected .last-run.json artifact reliably.
test-login secret mismatch (401 Invalid test login secret) between the harness default and the running API instance silently blocked an entire e2e run until diagnosed.

Decision-coverage gate parser required exact bullet formatting (`- **D-NN:**` with colon inside the bold group, tag also inside the bold group) — two failed attempts before the correct placement was found.
git index.lock transient contention blocked a tracking commit mid-wave.
Two separate executor agents ran the forbidden `git stash` command under pressure, requiring self-caught recovery and manual stash-list verification.
The account session limit killed both a plan-33 planner and the plan-22/29 exit-gate agent mid-task, requiring inline orchestrator recovery of partially-completed work.
CodeRabbit CLI hit its 150-file diff limit on the full phase diff, requiring a manual split into directory-scoped review passes.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility, requiring a workaround via `gh api -X PATCH`.

restore-to-different-parent write re-homing is the same bug class as the move fix (68.1-31) but was left unfixed since it's not a currently-shipped flow (captured as pending todo 2026-07-03-restore-to-different-parent-write-rehoming.md).
Codebase drift check flagged 143 structural elements since the last mapping — /gsd-map-codebase refresh recommended but not run.

Phase branch feat/web-client-runtime-integration is ~60 commits ahead of origin, unpushed as of the ship-phase invocation; commit subjects need conventional rewording (git filter-branch) before PR per the ship-phase workflow.

ship-phase workflow (verify/secure/validate/simplify/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit/ship/resolve-reviews/extract-learnings) was in progress at transcript end — security audit, Nyquist validation, simplify review, SDK E2E suite, and split CodeRabbit passes all launched but not yet reported back.
